title: not great for anything where fat needs to drain
text: not great for anything where fat needs to drain. there is not enough tilt to the plates, the fat on burgers will pool and spatter when they super-heat, instead of draining into the fat catcher.  I quickly returned this to try something else.  the temps are also super inaccurate, getting as much as 100 degrees hotter than the setting.  it might be fine for panninis, certainly not burgers
